title: When K-pop meets digital fashion: Behind-the-scenes story of ae-aespa's Whiplash!
description: Recently, the behind-the-scenes creative story of the popular K-pop group aespa's new song "Whiplash" has been revealed! summary: ```markdown # When K-pop Meets Digital Fashion: Behind-the-Scenes Story of ae-aespa's "Whiplash" ## Introduction Hello, I'm Park Jin-beom, and I work on visual creative projects under the name TAGIREN. Recently, I had the opportunity to work on the character artwork for aespa's "We Flash" album. Hi, I'm Yon Sanchez, a digital fashion creator and 3D artist. My work focuses on creating realistic and visually appealing clothing. I collaborated with Jin-beom on the "We Flash Universe" project. ## The Beginning of Collaboration Two years ago, while preparing for an online lecture, I wanted to explain to my students how to make clothes and utilize existing clothing assets. At that time, I was searching for assets to use. Yon had a wealth of professionally and systematically produced clothing, so I decided to reach out to him to explain how to customize these items for my students. That's when I connected with Yon, and we became friends. I looked at Jin-beom's Instagram and felt that he truly knew what he was doing. I loved his style and wanted to work with him. ## Character Artwork and Collaboration The character artwork for I-aespa was uploaded to my SNS via SM Entertainment. After seeing the previous character artwork, I was grateful when Jin-beom contacted me regarding this new project. It was a fantastic opportunity at the time. I have always pursued a style that allowed me to redesign the I-aespa character and create new clothing, which made working on this project enjoyable and meaningful. During this time, I was in touch with Yon and was aware of his exceptional skills. I asked him to collaborate on the I-aespa costume production project. Jin-beom sent me a direct message expressing interest in collaborating, and without hesitation, I agreed. Our connection was very natural, and the collaboration was fluid. ## Project Dynamics From the beginning, the project had a clear direction. The process was smooth, as I quickly established the basic structure and then added the necessary details. Yon and I had previously collaborated on several occasions, which facilitated smooth communication for this project. Thanks to the collaboration between Clou and Marvelous Designer, we were able to work faster and more efficiently. Using Marvelous Designer allowed us more time to focus on concepts and details, leading to high-quality artwork. The compatibility of the files made reviewing them much easier. ## Career Aspirations Since working on the I-aespa "Reflash Universe" project, I have collaborated with other K-pop artists as well. While I aim to build a career in both the fashion and entertainment industries, my ultimate goal is to become a 3D artist across various fields, particularly as a 3D character artist. The I-aespa project opened many doors for me, leading to opportunities with fashion brands, the automotive industry, and projects that allow for continuous learning. I dream of creating my own fashion brand someday, but I recognize that it is a long-term goal, and I'm in no rush. I need to keep learning, exploring, meeting new people, and staying informed about trends. ## Tools of the Trade What is the most important part of your work? Clou is an essential aspect of my daily routine. It enables me to experiment digitally with different forms. I'm excited to share my new projects with you. Currently, I primarily use Marvelous Designer, and I find that the compatibility between Clou and Marvelous Designer is excellent. To achieve my goals, I believe that Marvelous Designer is a crucial tool that I will continue to use throughout my career. ## Future Goals What is your goal? To be continued in the next episode. ```
